note: Substrate §5.1 — BOTH typed reference kinds in one manifest. `kind: "candidate"` dereferences to another sealed manifest; `kind: "tuple"` dereferences to a bare execution-tuple digest. They are discriminated precisely so a consumer never has to guess which resolver to call, and multiple parents are legal because crossover and composition are the reference proposer's whole repertoire. This manifest is also the subject of the DSSE fixtures.
